name: ceo-inbox-list
description: List recent messages from the CEO's personal email inbox. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the CEO's personal email, do not call from other agents.

inputs.unread_only: boolean? (if true, only return unread messages, default true)
inputs.received_after_hours: number? (only return messages received in the last N hours, e.g. 24 for last day; ignored if received_after_timestamp is set)
inputs.received_after_timestamp: number? (unix timestamp in seconds — only return messages received after this time; takes precedence over received_after_hours)

outputs.messages: array of { id, threadId, from, subject, date, snippet, unread, folders, attachments: [{ id, filename, contentType, size }] }
